Name: Build and Upgrade Greenhouses
Author: ZengGod
Description:
[b][color=#efefef][size=6]本模组支持中英双语[/size][/color][/b]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=5]Mod Introduction[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4][b]Build & Upgrade Greenhouses[/b] is a SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley 1.6 that expands Robin's construction menu. Once the vanilla greenhouse has been repaired, you can keep building additional greenhouses. Each additional greenhouse has its own interior map and its own upgrade level, so upgrading one greenhouse never affects another.[/size]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=5]Key Features[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]After the vanilla greenhouse is repaired, additional greenhouses can be built repeatedly;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Each additional greenhouse has its own interior space and independent level;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]The vanilla greenhouse and all additional greenhouses share two unified Greenhouse Upgrade entries;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]An upgrade only affects the greenhouse you click;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Clicking a greenhouse at the wrong level is blocked and consumes no resources;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Build costs and both upgrade costs can be edited in GMCM;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]English and Simplified Chinese are supported;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Multiplayer is supported, with construction and upgrades handled by the host.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]Greenhouse Upgrades[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Greenhouse Upgrade (Level 1)[/b]: upgrades any Level 0 greenhouse to the 15×15 layout;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Greenhouse Upgrade (Level 2)[/b]: upgrades any Level 1 greenhouse to the 21×21 layout.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Select the entry at Robin's shop, then [b]click the greenhouse you want to upgrade[/b]. If the clicked greenhouse is not at the required level, the game will show a message and will not consume gold or materials. The vanilla greenhouse and additional greenhouses share one upgrade cost set, but each greenhouse stores its own level separately.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]Default Costs[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Build an additional greenhouse[/b]: 150,000g + Hardwood ×80 + Refined Quartz ×20 + Iridium Bar ×10, 3 days;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Level 1 upgrade[/b]: 200,000g + Hardwood ×200 + Iron Bar ×50 + Refined Quartz ×20, 3 days;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Level 2 upgrade[/b]: 500,000g + Hardwood ×500 + Gold Bar ×100 + Iridium Bar ×50, 3 days.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]All costs, the three material slots, material quantities, and construction days can be edited directly in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], or by editing [b]config.json[/b]. If an older config still uses the previous default material combination, it will be migrated to the new defaults on first load; other custom values are preserved.[/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.1.0[/b] or newer;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Optionally install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b];[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Place the [b]Build & Upgrade Greenhouses[/b] folder from the archive into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b];[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Repair the vanilla greenhouse in your save first; Robin's menu will then show the additional greenhouse and upgrade entries;[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Back up your save before updating.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]Important[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]Demolish all additional greenhouses in-game before uninstalling. Removing the mod directly can leave custom buildings in the save without their data, which may cause loading errors or broken buildings.[/size]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=5]模组介绍[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4][b]Bu[/b][b]ild & Upgrade Greenhouses[/b] 是《星露谷物语》1.6 的 SMAPI 模组，用来扩展罗宾的建造菜单。原版温室修复后，你可以继续建造追加温室；每座追加温室都有独立的室内地图和独立等级，扩建一座不会影响其他温室。[/size]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=5]主要功能[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]原版温室修复后，可重复建造追加温室；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]每座追加温室拥有独立室内空间和独立等级；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]原版温室和追加温室统一使用两个「温室升级」入口；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]升级只作用于鼠标点击的那一座温室；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]点错等级会被拦截，不会误扣资源；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]建造费用和两档升级费用都能在 GMCM 中修改；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]支持英文与简体中文；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]支持多人游戏，建造与升级由主机处理。[/size][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]温室升级[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]温室升级（等级 1）[/b]：把任意一座等级 0 温室升级为 15×15；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]温室升级（等级 2）[/b]：把任意一座等级 1 温室升级为 21×21。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]可在[/size][b][size=4]罗宾的木匠的商店[/size][/b][size=4]建造与升级温室，选中入口后，[/size][b][size=4]点击哪座温室，就升级哪座[/size][/b][size=4]。如果点击的温室等级[/size]
[size=4]不匹配，游戏会提示无法升级，并且不会扣除金币或材料。原版温室和追加温室共用同一套升级费用，但每座温室的等级分别保存。[/size][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]默认费用[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]建造追加温室[/b]：150,000g + 硬木 ×80 + 精炼石英 ×20 + 铱锭 ×10，3 天；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]等级 1 升级[/b]：200,000g + 硬木 ×200 + 铁锭 ×50 + 精炼石英 ×20，3 天；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]等级 2 升级[/b]：500,000g + 硬木 ×500 + 金锭 ×100 + 铱锭 ×50，3 天。[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]以上费用、三个材料槽位、材料数量和建造天数都可以在 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] 里直接输入修改；也可以手动编辑 [/size][size=4][b]config.json [/b][/size][size=4]。如果旧配置里还是旧版的默认材料组合，首次加载会自动迁移到新默认，其他自定义数值保留。[/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]安装[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]安装 [b]Stardew Valley 1.6 [/b]与 [b]SMAPI 4.1.0[/b] 或更高版本；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]可选安装 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]将压缩包中的[b]Build & Upgrade Greenhouses[/b]文件夹放入[b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b]；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]在存档中先修复原版温室，罗宾菜单才会显示追加温室和升级入口；[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]更新前建议备份存档。[/size][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]注意[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]卸载前请先在游戏里拆除所有追加温室。直接删除模组可能让存档中的自定义建筑失去对应数据，造成读档异常或建筑显示错误。[/size]
